action.sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', order_date) AS w, count(*) n, avg(delay_days) avg_delay, avg(CASE WHEN is_delayed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) delayed_share, min(CASE WHEN is_delayed THEN order_date END) first_delayed FROM supplier_delivery WHERE supplier_id='SUP-001' AND order_date BETWEEN '2024-02-10' AND '2024-04-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
